Select distinct compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id) and canonical_smiles (from compound_structures). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno (INNER JOIN). Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293277' and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Deduplicate on compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id ascending.
